data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that sends ICMP ECHO_REQUEST to network hosts.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to send ICMP echo requests (pings) to network hosts on Android and iOS. Provides a stream of ping response events for tracking network latency and reachability.
use_when: You need to check host reachability via ICMP in a Flutter app
You want to measure network latency to a specific server
avoid_when: Targeting platforms other than Android and iOS
You only need HTTP/HTTPS connectivity checks
strengths: Enables ICMP ping functionality on mobile
Stream-based interface for easy subscription to events
Supports configurable count, timeout, interval, and TTL
weaknesses: Only supports Android and iOS platforms
Not documented for web or desktop platforms
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. See example directory for complete usage.
